Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODWindowState

OpenWindows

Document Shell

The OpenWindows method opens all windows belonging to the specified draft.

void OpenWindows (in ODDraft draft);
draft
A reference to the open draft object.
DISCUSSION
If the draft is already open, then this method brings its windows to the front.

EXCEPTIONS
kODErrOutOfMemory
There is not enough memory to open all the windows.
SEE ALSO
The ODWindowState::CloseWindows method (page 855).
